story_overview: With a serious expression, Arun is featured in the Press Room, recognizable by a white mark on his forehead. The story follows a series of tense meetings as Rajesh watches Arun leave a hazy red chamber, and Vikram and Kiran later meet with Arun at a family home. The men eventually gather for a series of intense conversations in the Press Room.
